text: {"lessons":["Selling 25 shares of Stock A after a large gain felt rewarding, but one sale does not show that I can time prices; I should base future trades on my portfolio plan, not the pleasure of realizing a gain.","My account fell after the sale, but that does not establish that the sale caused the decline or that I should have acted differently; short-term outcomes are noisy.","Since I trade infrequently and prices are unpredictable, I should review holdings periodically for diversification and risk, then avoid reacting to ordinary month-to-month swings."]}
